links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of customized GPT on real ED ECGs versus emergency specialists
links.effect: ECG Reader-GPT achieved 24% accuracy (27% with clinical information) versus 77% (79%) for emergency medicine specialists.
links.quote: In Stage 1, specialists correctly interpreted 77% of ECGs, whereas ECG Reader-GPT achieved 24%.

links.outcome: AI ECG interpretation compared against emergency medicine specialists on same ECGs
links.effect: Specialists outperformed ECG Reader-GPT in all diagnostic subgroups and both stages (77% vs 24%; 79% vs 27%), so the AI would not have been selected over clinicians.
links.quote: EMSs consistently outperformed ECG Reader-GPT under all conditions, indicating that the model is currently insufficient for real-world ECG interpretation.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of a customized GPT model (ECG Reader-GPT) compared to emergency medicine specialists interpreting ECGs with and without clinical history, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
